in_sanskrit.name: Ekti
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Unique, Individual
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ekti एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ekti is a Sanskrit name that signifies being unique and individual. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ek' meaning 'one' and 'Ti' meaning 'two'. This name is believed to symbolize the unity of the self with the universe and the belief that every individual is unique in their own way.

in_hindi.name: एक
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक का मान वह जिसका संख्या 1 है।
